rules.rule: Behavior belongs in Rust. Ruby files under lib/ hold only vocabulary: constants, the error hierarchy, MiniRacer::Binary, the loader, and the pure compositions Context#load and #write_heap_snapshot. Flag new Ruby logic that converts values, validates options, or talks to V8.
Upstream sources are byte-identical copies. Flag any edit to vendor/ submodules or to the vendored TruffleRuby backend files.
Files inside the gem load each other with require_relative, never require, so a co-installed mini_racer gem cannot shadow them.
A behavior change that differs from mini_racer 0.22.1 needs a compat.toml entry (deviation with a reason) and a failing-first fixture. Flag observable behavior changes without one.
Comments explain a non-obvious why (hidden constraint, invariant, workaround). Flag comments that restate code, narrate changes, reference tickets or PRs, or are tombstones.
